title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
title_zh: RRSI：Agent Harness 的正则化递归自我改进
abstract_en: An LLM agent's capability is largely magnified by its harness, namely the prompts, control flow, tooling, memory, and context management surrounding the frozen backbone model. Recent methods increasingly automate this process by iteratively proposing and selecting component-wise edits of an agent harness, practically establishing a form of recursive self-improvement (RSI) at the agent-system level. However, such recursive evolution may overfit by memorizing the training tasks, showing large in-distribution gains that shrink or even vanish on out-of-distribution benchmarks. We introduce Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses (RRSI), which incorporates the principles of regularizations into harness self-improvement by constraining the evolution candidate proposal and selection. The proposer operates with a temporally annealed budget, limiting how many edits a candidate can bundle, and it encourages unexplored trajectories based on evolution history. The selector is equipped with a critic and a pruner: the critic screens benchmark-specific proposals, while the pruner, removes changes that are too small, too expensive, or no longer useful. Together these constraints favor reusable agent mechanisms over benchmark-specific ones or even noises. Across eight benchmarks spanning coding, agentic workspace and engineering design tasks, RRSI gains up to 14.1 points on the split it evolves against and up to 4.7 points on the five out-of-distribution benchmarks, while producing a harness that runs on 30% fewer policy tokens than the unregularized evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/google-research/rrsi and project page is https://regularized-rsi.com/.
abstract_zh: LLM Agent 的能力不仅取决于冻结的 backbone model，还受到 prompts、控制流、工具、memory 与 context management 等 harness 组件的显著影响。现有方法通过迭代提出并选择组件级修改，实现了 Agent 系统层面的递归自我改进（Recursive Self-Improvement, RSI），但容易过拟合训练任务，导致分布内性能提升难以迁移到分布外基准。本文提出 Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses（RRSI），通过约束候选修改的提出与选择过程引入正则化。Proposer 使用随时间退火的预算限制单个候选包含的修改数量，并依据历史鼓励探索未覆盖的演化轨迹；Selector 配备 critic 与 pruner，分别过滤特定于基准的修改，以及删除过小、成本过高或已失去作用的变化。这些约束促进可复用 Agent 机制的保留，抑制基准特定模式与噪声。在涵盖 coding、agentic workspace 和 engineering design 的八个基准上，RRSI 相比未正则化演化方法，在演化所针对的数据划分上最高提升 14.1 个百分点，在五个分布外基准上最高提升 4.7 个百分点，同时使 harness 的 policy token 消耗减少 30%。
key_points_zh: 核心问题是 Agent Harness 的递归演化容易记忆训练任务，造成显著分布内收益却难以泛化到分布外基准。
Proposer 通过退火编辑预算限制候选修改规模，并依据演化历史鼓励探索未覆盖的修改轨迹。
Selector 结合 critic 与 pruner，过滤基准特定修改，并移除过小、过贵或已无效的变化。
在八个 coding、agentic workspace 与 engineering design 基准上，RRSI 分布内最高提升 14.1 个百分点，分布外最高提升 4.7 个百分点。
RRSI 在保持性能收益的同时，将 harness 的 policy token 使用量降低 30%，表明正则化有助于学习可复用机制。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong agent-harness evolution paper that regularizes recursive improvement against overfitting while improving out-of-distribution performance and runtime efficiency.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇优秀的Agent Harness演化工作，通过正则化递归改进减少过拟合，同时提升分布外性能和运行效率。
